android.desc:
PosteID is the official Poste Italiane app for the new digital identity that allows you to access public administration services and private individuals participating in the Public Digital Identity System (SPID).

REGISTRATION WITH ELECTRONIC DOCUMENT
If you have an electronic document—an identity card (CIE) or passport—you can use the PosteID app to verify your identity online, without having to visit a post office.

PASSWORD-LESS ACCESS VIA QR CODE
You can authorize access requests using a QR Code. Simply scan the QR Code on the service login page and enter your PosteID code into the app.

ACCESS WITH FINGERPRINT
You can quickly authorize access using your fingerprint as an alternative to the PosteID code.

SPID LEVEL 3 ACCESS
To authorize access to services requiring SPID 3, you must have a SPID 3 PIN. To obtain it, log in to your personal area at https://posteid.poste.it

USE THE APP AS A PIN GENERATOR
You can also access services with a temporary PIN generated in the app, even if the app is offline.

Once you have generated the PIN, enter it on the service login page after entering your username and password.

View the accessibility declarations at https://www.poste.it/dichiarazione-accessibilita.html.

Note: App features and support are available in Italian only. If you need to contact customer service, call us at +39 06.977.977.77  

 

PosteID is the official Poste Italiane app for the new digital ID that lets you access online the services of the Public Administration and authorized Private Bodies with the Digital Identity Public System (SPID).

If you already have an electronic document - Identity Card (CIE) or Passport - you can use the PosteID App for online identification, without going to the post office.
